outcomes.name: rsi-dip-tighter-tp
outcomes.changedWhat: exit_conditions (RSI>50 instead of >60), take_profit_pct (2.5% vs 4%), max_hold_bars (32 vs 64), pairs (removed low-edge coins: SOL, XRP, ALGO, ICP), expected_holding_time_min (120 vs 240).
outcomes.why: Parent is fee-fragile: 0.60% round-trip kills thin edges. Tighter TP (2.5%) aligns with realistic 15m reversals and cuts hold time by 50%, reducing fee drag. Pair culling removes BTC (−2.73 OOS), ALGO (−0.16), ICP (−1.36) — focus on WLD/NEAR winners. Faster exit at RSI 50 captures the core dip-recovery without waiting for full trend confirmation.
outcomes.expectedImprovement: OOS winrate should stabilize >50% (fewer false holds); net-PnL per trade improves via lower fee pressure; robustness ratio >0.65 by reducing parameter sensitivity.
outcomes.failureCriteria: OOS winrate remains <42% OR OOS net-PnL stays negative OR max_drawdown exceeds 1.5%.

outcomes.name: rsi-dip-vol-filter
outcomes.changedWhat: entry_conditions (added atr_gt filter), pairs (removed low-edge coins).
outcomes.why: Parent's regimePerformance shows low-volatility regime lost −1.01 PnL on 1 trade. ATR>0.8% gate ensures only trades with sufficient expected move (>0.8% volatility) are taken, filtering out noise trades that lose to fees. Pair culling removes BTC/ALGO/ICP losers. Keeps original TP/SL to preserve edge on high-vol entries.
outcomes.expectedImprovement: OOS winrate >50% by eliminating low-vol false signals; robustness >0.65 by regime-filtering; fee fragility reduced via entry selectivity.
outcomes.failureCriteria: OOS trades drop below 5 (filter too strict) OR OOS winrate <45% (filter ineffective) OR net-PnL remains negative.

outcomes.name: rsi-dip-ema-confirm
outcomes.changedWhat: entry_conditions (added price_within_pct_of_ema filter), pairs (removed low-edge coins).
outcomes.why: Parent's parameter-cliff flag suggests RSI 30 alone is unstable. EMA-proximity filter adds structural confirmation: only shallow dips (within 1.5% of trend) are traded, avoiding deep reversals that require outsized moves to recover. This reduces false-signal entries and improves mean-reversion reliability. Pair culling removes BTC/ALGO/ICP losers.
outcomes.expectedImprovement: OOS winrate >50% via higher-quality entry confirmation; robustness >0.65 by reducing parameter sensitivity; fee fragility reduced via entry selectivity.
outcomes.failureCriteria: OOS trades drop below 8 (filter too strict) OR OOS winrate <45% (filter ineffective) OR net-PnL remains negative.
